title: ❓ Frequently Asked Questions
description: Everything you need to know about CIPHER — the most secure and undetectable CS2 external cheat suite. Read carefully to understand how our advanced protection keeps you safe.

fields.name: 🛡️ Is CIPHER safe from VAC?
fields.value: **Absolutely.** CIPHER uses advanced kernel-level protection that operates completely invisible to VAC. Our external architecture ensures maximum safety. We've been undetected since launch with zero bans reported.

fields.name: 🔄 What happens after a CS2 update?
fields.value:
After major CS2 patches, we update the software within **24-48 hours**. You'll receive a new loader with updated compatibility. Your license key remains the same — just download and run the new version.

**Important:** Any downtime caused by CS2 updates will be compensated and added to your license duration.

fields.name: 🛠️ Troubleshooting: Loader won't start
fields.value:
• Run as **administrator** (required)
• Disable **Secure Boot** in BIOS
• Disable antivirus temporarily
• Make sure you're on **real hardware** (no VMs)
• Check if Windows Defender blocked the file
• Restart your PC and try again

fields.name: 💬 Need more help?
fields.value:
Open a support ticket and our team will assist you. Please include:
• Screenshot of any error
• Windows version

Our support team typically responds within 1-2 hours.
